name: crypt.decrypt
description: Decrypts Base64 ciphertext with a Base64-decoded key and required Base64 IV using AES CBC or ECB.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Base64 key decoded before it is passed to AES.

parameters.name: iv
parameters.description: Base64 IV decoded before mode handling. This argument is required, including for ECB.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: AES mode. The AES- prefix is removed when present. Defaults to AES-CBC.
